# Inbox paging over more than one store page (16 conversations on the device; the app
# uses 16 in the sim too). Sends to 20 made-up hashes (3 s apart, the send limit), then
# Inbox: N N = page 3 of 3.  run-script.bat scripts\inbox_pages.txt inboxp fresh
expect 60000 [BOOT] ready
serial wiz skip
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000101 hello 1
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000102 hello 2
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000103 hello 3
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000104 hello 4
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000105 hello 5
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000106 hello 6
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000107 hello 7
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000108 hello 8
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000109 hello 9
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010a hello 10
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010b hello 11
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010c hello 12
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010d hello 13
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010e hello 14
wait 4200
serial msg 0000000000000000000000000000010f hello 15
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000110 hello 16
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000111 hello 17
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000112 hello 18
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000113 hello 19
wait 4200
serial msg 00000000000000000000000000000114 hello 20
wait 4200
serial rmconv
expect 5000 [MSG] conversation
wait 2000
key BACK
wait 1500
key I
expect 5000 [LIST] 20 conversations
wait 2000
key N
key N
wait 1500
shot inbox-p3.png
quit
